description: Use this tool whenever a user asks about the IRS Form 8880 Retirement Savings Contributions Credit (Saver's Credit under IRC Sec. 25B), the new 2027 SECURE 2.0 50% Federal Treasury Saver's Match direct deposit (IRC Sec. 6433), the Form 8880 Line 4 prior-distribution reduction rule, or how lowering AGI via pre-tax 401(k)/IRA deductions unlocks the credit/match.

grossIncome.description: Gross income in USD before pre-tax 401(k)/IRA deductions.

preTax401kOrIraDeduction.description: Pre-tax 401(k), Solo 401(k), SEP, Traditional IRA, or HSA deductions reducing AGI in USD.

spouseContribution.description: Spouse's annual IRA or 401(k) contribution in USD if Married Filing Jointly (first $2,000 counts).

testingPeriodDistributions.description: Retirement distributions taken during the Form 8880 Line 4 testing period in USD.

year.description: Tax year (2025, 2026 for Form 8880, or 2027 for SECURE 2.0 50% Saver's Match).

yourContribution.description: Taxpayer's annual IRA or 401(k) contribution in USD (first $2,000 counts).

name: calculate_savers_credit_and_2027_match
title: Calculate IRS Form 8880 Saver's Credit (2025-2026) & SECURE 2.0 50% Treasury Saver's Match (2027+)
